label: Self-giving in an accessible history at a moment is efficient self-causation there and then
paraphrase: OPEN analyst cross-sense causal bridge, attribution deferred: in every history v accessible from the selected world and at every moment t, if c exercises strict GivesAt v c c t toward its OWN being, then in v at t c is an efficient cause of its own being (EfficientlyCausesAt v t c c esse). EfficientlyCausesAt v t is the here-and-now efficient causing of EFFICIENT_CAUSING_2 read in history v at moment t; both indices are kept, so nothing is moved between histories or moments. The bridge concerns only the self-edge. It does not identify the frame's CausesIn perfection-causation relation with efficient causes, require a physical temporal interval, or claim any real self-giving is possible. It is separate from the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (definition 8934912c), which passes from CausesIn to the tenseless EfficientlyCausesEsse only for causes distinct from their effect and so cannot cover the self-edge.
